# nb-studio conversation

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## conversation attachment download

Download a file sent in chat

The bytes of a file sent with a message, for the conversation's owner, or a run of its agent on that conversation (by its run token); an upload not sent yet, for its uploader. A safe raster image is served inline unless `download=true`; anything else, SVG and HTML included, as a download. Always with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox` and `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

```bash
nb-studio conversation attachment download <file>
```

| Argument | Description                           |
| -------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `file`   | The file id, as the message lists it. |

| Flag    | Type | Description                                           |
| ------- | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `--out` | path | Where to save the file, or a directory to save it in. |

**Output:** A file, saved in the current directory under its own name or where `--out` says; with `--json`, `result.data` says where it went.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `agents.runs/self`.

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/chatAttachments/{attachmentId}/content` (`agentsDownloadChatAttachment`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio conversation attachment download <file-id>
```

## conversation attachment upload

Upload a file to send in chat

One file as the `file` field of a multipart body, at most 20971520 bytes. It is the caller's alone until it is sent with a message (`attachmentIds`); one never sent is purged after a day.

```bash
nb-studio conversation attachment upload --file <path>
```

| Flag     | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `--file` | path | (required)  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/chatAttachments` (`agentsUploadChatAttachment`)

## conversation create

Create a conversation

With the given agent, or the caller's default chat agent when none is named; for an online agent, `model` chooses one of its `models` to answer with (400, `metadata.reason` `MODEL_NOT_LISTED`, for any other).

```bash
nb-studio conversation create
```

| Flag       | Type   | Description                                                                                                    |
| ---------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--agent`  | string |                                                                                                                |
| `--title`  | string |                                                                                                                |
| `--source` | string |                                                                                                                |
| `--model`  | json   | An online agent: the entry of its list (`ChatAgent.models`) to answer with; the agent's default when left out. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/conversations` (`agentsCreateConversation`)

## conversation fallback

Switch a conversation to the default agent

Continues the conversation with the default chat agent while its own agent cannot answer; a runner conversation whose default is not a runner agent continues with the online fallback agent.

```bash
nb-studio conversation fallback <conversation>
```

| Argument       | Description |
| -------------- | ----------- |
| `conversation` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/conversations/{conversationId}/fallback` (`agentsFallbackConversation`)

## conversation list

List the caller's conversations

The conversations the caller started, newest message first, a page at a time; a conversation is its owner's alone.

```bash
nb-studio conversation list
```

| Flag           | Type                 | Description  |
| -------------- | -------------------- | ------------ |
| `--query`      | string               |              |
| `--archived`   | true \| false \| all |              |
| `--agent`      | string               |              |
| `--source`     | string               |              |
| `--limit`      | integer              | (default 30) |
| `--page-token` | string               |              |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `title`, `agent.name`, `lastMessageAt`, `read`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/conversations` (`agentsListConversations`)

## conversation message list

List a conversation's messages

Newest page first, each page in order; `after` reads only what arrived since a `seq`, and a page token the page before.

```bash
nb-studio conversation message list <conversation>
```

| Argument       | Description |
| -------------- | ----------- |
| `conversation` |             |

| Flag           | Type    | Description  |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `--after`      | integer |              |
| `--limit`      | integer | (default 50) |
| `--page-token` | string  |              |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `seq`, `role`, `content.content`, `createdAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/conversations/{conversationId}/messages` (`agentsListConversationMessages`)

## conversation message send

Send a message

Adds the caller's message and hands it to the conversation's agent: a new run, or the open one. The answer arrives as messages later; `run` says what happened to the agent. `attachmentIds` sends the caller's uploads with it; any other id answers 400 and nothing is sent.

```bash
nb-studio conversation message send <conversation> --content <string>
```

| Argument       | Description |
| -------------- | ----------- |
| `conversation` |             |

| Flag        | Type   | Description                                                                              |
| ----------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--content` | string | Markdown; empty only when files are sent. (required; alias -m; or --content-file <path>) |
| `--attach`  | path   | A file to send with the message (repeatable). (uploaded first, repeatable)               |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/conversations/{conversationId}/messages` (`agentsSendConversationMessage`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio conversation message send <conversation> -m "What is left on PM-12?"
nb-studio conversation message send <conversation> -m "See the log" --attach build.log
```

## conversation title set

Name the token's conversation

A run on a conversation names it (at most 40 characters); `meta.message` says so. Refused once the conversation's owner renamed it (`CONVERSATION_CONFLICT`, `metadata.reason` `titleLocked`).

```bash
nb-studio conversation title set <title>
```

| Argument | Description                       |
| -------- | --------------------------------- |
| `title`  | The title, at most 40 characters. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** Only agents in a run; needs the action `agents.runs/self`.

**Request:** `PATCH /api/agents/runs/current/conversation` (`agentsSetCurrentRunConversationTitle`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio conversation title set "Tidy the login issues"
```

## conversation update

Rename, archive or choose the model of a conversation

`model` picks one of the online conversation's `models` for its next runs (null: the agent's default); 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` with `reason: MODEL_NOT_LISTED` when the agent does not list it.

```bash
nb-studio conversation update <conversation>
```

| Argument       | Description |
| -------------- | ----------- |
| `conversation` |             |

| Flag         | Type    | Description |
| ------------ | ------- | ----------- |
| `--title`    | string  |             |
| `--archived` | boolean |             |
| `--model`    | json    |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/agents/conversations/{conversationId}` (`agentsUpdateConversation`)
